title: Vaulted Checkout build plan v0.4 (parallel tracks, model + effort per task)
principles: Two builders (Claude Code, Codex) + Gemini 4 Argon on Sunday. Every task has an owner and a cross-checker from the other vendor.
Handoff contract per task: files touched, tests run, open questions, written to docs/handoff/<task>.md so any model can resume if another runs out of tokens.
Interfaces first (P-1 contracts), then parallel tracks. Contracts are the only thing two tracks share.
Smallest trust surface: signer Reactor is tiny, reviewed by both vendors, frozen after P0 gate.
No task starts on a claim marked unverified; it starts by verifying.

model_key.CC-haiku: Claude Code, Haiku 5.5 (boilerplate, formatting, doc generation)
model_key.GPT-codex: Codex (GPT), as available on Robert's plan; use highest reasoning for review
model_key.ARGON: Gemini 4 Argon via AI Studio/Antigravity (Sunday only, needs credits/access at event); thinking_level high for design/verification loops, medium for building

bt_applications_to_create.name: vc-management
bt_applications_to_create.purpose: Bootstrap only: create apps, deploy/update Reactors via bt CLI
bt_applications_to_create.rules: Held by Robert only, in shell env BT_MANAGEMENT_KEY (not flag, not repo, not any agent). Delete after P0 if no longer needed. Never give to an AI agent session.

bt_applications_to_create.name: vc-key-provisioner
bt_applications_to_create.purpose: One-time: tokenize freshly generated test wallet key (type token, data field, no metadata)
bt_applications_to_create.rules: Delete the application right after tokenizing. Local key copy shredded.

bt_applications_to_create.name: vc-invoker
permissions: reactor invoke permission, exact name UNVERIFIED (check Permissions API GET /permissions?application_type=private)
bt_applications_to_create.rules: No token:read, no reactor:update. Cannot read plaintext key.

bt_applications_to_create.name: signer-reactor runtime permissions
bt_applications_to_create.purpose: Lets the Reactor detokenize the key token
permissions: token:read (scoped by access rule/container if supported, UNVERIFIED)
bt_applications_to_create.rules: Only this Reactor can reveal the key.

tasks.task: Create BT apps per table; confirm permission names via Permissions API; confirm token type for key; confirm Reactor invoke contract

Write contracts: openapi for merchant, JSON schemas for x402 v2 PaymentRequired/PaymentPayload, Reactor request/response, MCP tool schemas, audit event schema, order+payment-attempt state machine (incl. settlement_unknown)
tasks.check: GPT-codex high: attack for replay/idempotency/state gaps

tasks.task: Pin versions + lockfile spike: @x402/* 2.28.0, viem 2.57.11, MCP SDK choice (sdk 1.32.2 vs server 2.4.0), node24
tasks.check: CC-sonnet runs install on clean machine

tracks.name: Signer Reactor (critical path, Sat am to pm)

tasks.task: Minimal Reactor: detokenize key, build EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization inside Reactor (fixed domain/contract/chain/asset, integer units, validAfter/Before bounds, random nonce), return x402 v2 payload. Hard rules from configuration: allowlisted payTo, max amount, chain 84532, USDC address
tasks.check: GPT-codex high independent review of signing code + rule bypass attempts

tasks.task: Idempotent re-sign: same orderId+attempt returns same authorization (nonce derived deterministically from orderId+attemptId+secret, or supplied by trusted merchant and validated) so retries never mint a second spendable auth
Negative tests: wrong chain, asset, payTo, amount, expired, over cap, malformed; confirm no key/PAN/raw proof in logs (allowlisted audit fields only)
Deploy via bt CLI (reactors create/update, --image node24, --package-json, --configuration, --permissions token:read), benchmark cold/warm

tracks.gate: Reactor-signed auth verifies (recovered address) and settles once on Base Sepolia via facilitator; negatives rejected; both vendors sign off. FREEZE signer code.

tracks.name: Merchant (parallel with T1 after T0.2, Sat)

tasks.task: Manifest at /.well-known/commerce-manifest (documented subset), products, orders, pay with x402 v2 headers, facilitator verify/settle client
Payment-attempt store: atomic claim, immutable order price, states created/claimed/signed/submitted/settled/settlement_unknown/failed; reconcile job
Conformance checklist vs consortium v0.1.0 HTML whitepaper, list deviations (x402 v2, paymentStatus naming, card simulated=not built)

tracks.name: MCP adapter (after T0.2, parallel with T1/T2 using mocks, Sat pm)

tasks.task: stdio MCP server, fixed adapter profile (tools list_products, create_order, pay_order, get_order), pinned merchant origin, no model-supplied payee/amount at pay time
tasks.check: CC-sonnet integration test with Claude Code as client

tasks.task: pay_order flow: 402 parse, local policy precheck, call Reactor via vc-invoker, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, return receipt + explorer link; above cap = reject with clear message
Failure injection: lost signing response, lost settlement response, restart mid-attempt, duplicate pay, facilitator 5xx; assert converge to existing outcome
Audit view (small): order, decision, signing status, settlement status, receipt, basescan link
Secret scan + log review + credential separation check (invoker cannot read key; management key absent from repo/history)

tracks.name: Sunday Argon track (needs hackathon access; all optional, never on critical path)

tasks.task: Voice approval prototype for roadmap story: gemini-3.8-live reads the pending over-cap request, manager says yes; output is a mock approval UI only (no payment authority)
tasks.check: CC-opus reviews that voice has no authority path

tasks.task: Independent adversarial review of signer + merchant: Argon at thinking_level high, 1M context, whole repo
Interactive HTML architecture diagram + AGENTS.md lessons (guide pattern 5)
3 consecutive runs under 3 min incl. one policy rejection; backup recording; pre-funded wallet
Article from observed behavior only; no job-search mention; no em dashes; state what is simulated and what is trusted
tasks.check: GPT-codex fact check against repo + codex-review-1

parallel_map: After T0: T1 || T2 || T3 (mocks) run at once. T4 needs T1+T2+T3. T5 independent of T4 if repo is readable. T6 after T4.
token_handoff_rule: If a model is out of budget: stop at a green commit, write docs/handoff/<task>.md (state, next step, failing tests), other vendor continues the same task id. Keep tasks small enough to finish in one session.
budget_hint: Opus/high only for T0.2, T1.1, T1.2, T2.2, T4.3 (security-critical). Everything else Sonnet/med or Codex/med. Haiku for docs.
